subject: Observability staging: runbook gaps, dashboards & tracing hooks
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmehealth.com>, Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Observability staging: runbook gaps, dashboards & tracing hooks

Hi Samir & Olivia —

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Per our call, I wanted to capture the immediate gaps we saw in the staging run and align on owners for the first two-week activation sprint. High-level asks:

- Runbook completeness: identify missing playbook steps for API error triage and model fallback.
- Dashboard coverage: map SLO signals to dashboards and confirm owner for each widget.
- Tracing hooks: ensure trace context is propagated from edge -> router -> inference runtime.

I've attached an initial draft runbook and a dashboard mapping sheet. Proposed owners (please confirm):
- Runbook: Marissa (primary), Ben (backup)
- Dashboards: Laura (owner of dashboard mapping)
- Tracing hooks verification: Ben + Acme infra (Samir)

Next steps: can we do a 30-min sync on Wednesday to triage the runbook gaps and lock down the dashboard list? Olivia, can you surface any staging-specific constraints (ingest rate, masking requirements) before then?

Thanks —

Stephanie Nguyen
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: acme-observability-runbook-v1.md, dashboard-mapping-acme.xlsx

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmehealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>, Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Observability staging: runbook gaps, dashboards & tracing hooks

Thanks Stephanie —

Quick clarifications from our side:
- We have a masking proxy in front of the inference router that strips auth headers on replay; we will need guidance on how Redwood suggests verifying trace context while preserving PHI masking.
- Staging ingest peaks at ~1.2x of the usual test load during model churn, so any dashboard rate thresholds should account for brief spikes.

Happy to join Wednesday. For owners, Ben + our infra lead (Iccar) can run the tracing smoke test. I'll confirm exact times by EOD.

Samir
Director, Platform Engineering
Acme Health

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmehealth.com>, Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 08:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Observability staging: runbook gaps, dashboards & tracing hooks

Looping internal owners with a short plan.

Planned checklist for first sprint (items I will coordinate):
1) Tracing verification: create a small harness that issues 100 short requests with trace headers; verify span continuity and sampling behavior. (deliverable: tracing-hook-checklist.pdf)
2) Error taxonomy: propose normalized error buckets (client/validation, backend runtime, model fallbacks, infra throttles). Draft will be sent by EOD Wednesday.
3) Dashboard gating: map 8 critical widgets (latency p95, p99, token throughput, cost/token, error rate by bucket, cache hit rate, queue depth, DS load).

Marissa — can you take the runbook draft and add step-by-step triage for model-fallback events? Laura — can you confirm dashboard permissions for Acme on staging?

Ben Carter
Implementation Lead, CS Ops
Redwood Inference
attachments: tracing-hook-checklist.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmehealth.com>, Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 10:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Updated runbook draft + inline gaps resolved

Forwarding updated runbook with inline notes. Key changes:
- Added explicit rollback checklist for bad model rollout (steps, required approvals, monitoring windows).
- Expanded "Who to call" list with on-call SRE links and paging window (6am–10pm local) for Acme staging.
- Added sample play for degraded cache hit rate (includes KV cache flush and forced prefix warm).

I'm attaching the revised runbook (acme-observability-runbook-v1.md) and a short dashboard mapping (dashboard-mapping-acme.xlsx). Please review the model fallback play — I added an optional step to route to a quantized variant for latency-sensitive traffic; that needs Ops confirmation.

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
attachments: acme-observability-runbook-v1.md, dashboard-mapping-acme.xlsx

Thanks all — this looks good. A couple of confirmations from Acme staging team:
- We can provide a short-lived IAM role for Redwood to access the staging telemetry stream (Laura, if you can confirm the permission scope that would help).
- We prefer the "quantized variant" routing as a temporary mitigation during peak churn, but need the rollback window defined (we prefer a 30-minute canary).

Agree to a Wednesday 30-min checkpoint next week (Dec 23) to mark sprint start. Samir will loop in Iccar for the tracing run; Ben + Iccar will co-own the verification tests.

Olivia Grant
Product Operations Manager
Acme Health
